intent: A quick, confident quizmaster: curious on the question, playful on the countdown, satisfied on the reveal, genuinely interested in the one fact that makes the answer stick.
pacing_profile: question on the map at zero, three quick options, a 1.5-s beat, a warm reveal, three short see-it beats, a tease and a loop
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).

lines.text: Tennis fans, no cheating now, which Grand Slam is still played on grass?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat
lines.text: Wimbledon, the US Open, or the Australian Open?
It's Wimbledon, in south-west London, on grass since eighteen seventy-seven.
First Championships: twenty-two men, one event, two hundred watching.
The US Open left grass in nineteen seventy-five, Australia in nineteen eighty-eight.
The courts: pure ryegrass, cut to eight millimetres.
Did you get it? Like and subscribe for more sport.

title: In which US state was BASKETBALL invented?
